mentions.name: Financial Censorship Monitor (nofunds.org)
mentions.description: This website monitors and documents financial censorship: how money is used as a political weapon to silence journalists, activists, and civil society through frozen assets, blocked accounts, sanctions, and payment bans. It compiles a comprehensive list of such cases using the Claude API combined with manual work, with the site launching live within two months given API rate limits for processing articles. The project is part of the author's master's thesis and argues that Bitcoin can be a marginal tool for resisting financial censorship and deplatforming.
mentions.problem: Journalists, activists, and civil society are silenced through financial censorship — assets frozen, accounts blocked, sanctions imposed, and payments banned — turning money into a political weapon.
mentions.audience: People whose bank accounts may be endangered, including journalists, activists, and civil society
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a financial censorship monitor at https://nofunds.org/, that tells a story of how money has been turned into a political weapon to silence journalists, activists, and civil society by freezing assets, blocking accounts, sanctioning, and banning payments.
